name: admin-settings-theme-changed
js: const c = '#6B3F60'; const i = document.querySelector('[data-testid=theme-primary-color]'); i.value = c; i.setAttribute('value', c); document.querySelector('[data-testid=theme-primary-swatch]').style.background = c; document.querySelector('.preview-header').style.background = c;

name: admin-settings-theme-saved
js: const c = '#6B3F60'; const i = document.querySelector('[data-testid=theme-primary-color]'); i.value = c; i.setAttribute('value', c); document.querySelector('[data-testid=theme-primary-swatch]').style.background = c; document.querySelector('.preview-header').style.background = c; const at = document.querySelector('.page-header'); const n = document.createElement('div'); for (const a of at.attributes) { if (a.name.startsWith('_ngcontent')) n.setAttribute(a.name, ''); } n.className = 'alert alert-success'; n.textContent = 'Theme saved successfully'; at.after(n);
